sloka: ततः शिखरम् आरुह्य रामो दशरथ आत्मजः ।कूर्म मीन समाकीर्णम् अपश्यत् सलिल आशयम् ॥६-४-९६॥।।
transliteration: tataḥ śikharam āruhya rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।kūrma mīna samākīrṇam apaśyat salila āśayam ॥6-4-96॥।।

translations.english: Then Rama the son of Dasaratha on climbing to the top (of Mahendra mountain) observed the ocean inhabited by tortoises and fish.
